name: followupboss-mcp-server
description: Talk to your Follow Up Boss CRM in plain English. 160 tools covering the full API.
long_description:
A Model Context Protocol server for the Follow Up Boss CRM, built by a working Austin real estate broker.

Covers 100% of the official Follow Up Boss API across 160 tools — people, deals, tasks, appointments, calls, texts, notes, pipelines, stages, smart lists, templates, webhooks, and more.

**You supply your own Follow Up Boss API key.** It is stored by Claude Desktop, passed to the server on your own machine, and never sent anywhere else. Nothing runs on the author's infrastructure.

**Safe Mode is on by default**, which hides all 23 delete tools and leaves 137 available. Turn it off only if you genuinely need destructive operations.

Some Follow Up Boss endpoints are marked "Restricted — Registered Systems Only" and additionally require your own registered system name and key. Those are optional; leave them blank and the remaining tools work normally.

tools.name: listPeople
tools.description: List and filter contacts in your Follow Up Boss account

tools.name: createTask
tools.description: Create a task for a contact

tools.name: createNote
tools.description: Add a note to a contact's timeline

tools.name: searchPeopleByTag
tools.description: Find contacts carrying a given tag

fub_api_key.title: Follow Up Boss API Key
fub_api_key.description: Your own API key. In Follow Up Boss go to Admin > API, then create a key. It stays on this machine.

safe_mode.title: Safe Mode
safe_mode.description: Leave on to hide all 23 delete tools (137 of 160 remain). Turn off only if you need to delete records.

fub_system.title: Registered System Name (optional)
fub_system.description: Only needed for endpoints Follow Up Boss marks "Restricted - Registered Systems Only", such as webhooks. Register your own at docs.followupboss.com/reference#identification.

fub_system_key.title: Registered System Key (optional)
fub_system_key.description: The key issued to you with the system name above. Leave blank unless you registered your own system.
